over the 3-5 years AFTER it closed. You are given ONE evidence slice assembled from
public primary sources (financial filings, reputable press) that describes ONLY the
post-deal trajectory -- how the combined company actually fared. You are
DELIBERATELY NOT shown how the deal was structured at closing (what transferred and
what did not), and you must NOT speculate about the deal's structure. Code STRICTLY
the documented realized outcome. If the slice does not let you determine a field,

Emit a single structured record with these fields.

C. FAILURE-PATHWAY INCIDENCE -- code strictly from the DOCUMENTED OUTCOME at the
3-5 year horizon. A pathway is a REALIZED DISRUPTION OVER TIME, not a structural
property of the deal.
  p4_pathway: Is there documented disruption specifically at the product/process
    interface (the acquired product could not be aligned with the operating
    processes over time; product-line/operations incoherence realized after the
    deal)? 1 = yes; 0 = no / none documented; uncertain.
  p5_pathway: Is there documented fracture specifically at the process/organization
    interface (operations vs people/management/culture; integration of operations
    broke against the organization over time)? 1 = yes; 0 = no / none documented;
    uncertain.
  t1_archetype: Is there documented incoherence in the controlling-intent archetype
    itself as it played out (e.g. an announced "merger of equals" that operated as
    one-sided dominance)? A channel SEPARATE from the product/process and
    process/organization pathways. 1 = yes; 0 = no; uncertain.
  t2_model: Is there documented incompatibility of the two business models
    (value-capture logics that could not be reconciled over time)? A channel
    SEPARATE from the pathways above. 1 = yes; 0 = no; uncertain.

D. performance_metric: the single best-documented post-deal outcome scalar in the
   slice (e.g. "divested 80.1% after ~108 months", "~$99bn goodwill write-down",
   "no divestiture; assets retained"). One short phrase. If none, "not documented".

# Outcome sub-dossier — Eastman Kodak Company realized record, fixed ~3-5-year window

> EVIDENTIARY STANDARD: every factual line ends with a `[SRC: <SEC accession / URL>]`
> tag pointing to a public primary source. A fact that cannot be so sourced is written
> `[UNVERIFIED]` and is never guessed. The registrant continued to file public annual
> reports, so the realized record is traced primarily to a Form 10-K falling within the
> fixed outcome window. This sub-dossier contains no information about how the
> transaction was structured at closing.

## Outcome window and public-reporting status
- Outcome window fixed at construction: the registrant's Annual Report on Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2016 — the annual report falling within the ~3-5-year post-reference window. [SRC: SEC accession 0001564590-17-003570, Form 10-K (FY2016), filed 2017-03-07]
- The Company remained a public SEC registrant through the window; its common stock has been listed and trading on the New York Stock Exchange under the symbol "KODK" since September 23, 2013. [SRC: SEC accession 0001564590-17-003570, Form 10-K (FY2016)]
- Financial statements for periods before September 3, 2013 (Predecessor) are not comparable with those after that date (Successor) because of the application of fresh-start accounting; the realized figures below are Successor-period results. [SRC: SEC accession 0001564590-17-003570, Form 10-K (FY2016)]

## Best-documented realized outcome scalar
- FY2016 net earnings attributable to Eastman Kodak Company were $15 million (total net earnings $16 million including noncontrolling interests), equal to 1% of revenue — a return to positive net earnings after net loss attributable to the Company of $(80) million in FY2015 and $(123) million in FY2014. [SRC: SEC accession 0001564590-17-003570, Form 10-K (FY2016)]
- Total net revenues declined across the window: $2,046 million (2014), $1,709 million (2015), and $1,543 million (2016). [SRC: SEC accession 0001564590-17-003570, Form 10-K (FY2016)]
- At the end of 2016 the Company employed the full-time equivalent of approximately 6,100 people globally, of whom approximately 2,700 were in the United States. [SRC: SEC accession 0001564590-17-003570, Form 10-K (FY2016)]
- Based on its December 31, 2016 analysis, the Company concluded that no impairment of goodwill was indicated. [SRC: SEC accession 0001564590-17-003570, Form 10-K (FY2016)]

## Realized record at the divested product / operations interface over time
- The sale of the Personalized Imaging and Document Imaging ("PI/DI") businesses to the pension-plan purchasing parties was consummated for net cash consideration of $325 million; certain jurisdictions were not transferred at the initial closing but at a series of deferred closings, with the final deferred closing occurring in September 2015. [SRC: SEC accession 0001564590-17-003570, Form 10-K (FY2016)]
- Until each deferred closing, the Company operated the PI/DI Business in the applicable jurisdictions and reported its results as Loss from discontinued operations, net of income taxes. [SRC: SEC accession 0001564590-17-003570, Form 10-K (FY2016)]
- Up to $35 million of the purchase price was subject to repayment if the PI/DI Business did not meet certain annual adjusted-EBITDA targets over the four-year period ending December 31, 2018; the PI/DI Business did not achieve the target for the year ended December 31, 2015, and $4 million (the maximum amount for 2015) was repaid to the purchasing parties in 2016. [SRC: SEC accession 0001564590-17-003570, Form 10-K (FY2016)]

## Post-reference balance-sheet management
- The second-lien term credit agreement entered at emergence was prepaid and terminated on November 15, 2016, and the asset-based revolving credit agreement was amended and restated on May 26, 2016. [SRC: SEC accession 0001564590-17-003570, Form 10-K (FY2016)]

## Outcome summary (realized record only)
- Within the fixed window the reorganized company continued as a public SEC registrant and, by FY2016, returned to a small positive net result ($15 million attributable to the Company) after consecutive prior-year losses, on declining revenues ($2,046M in 2014 to $1,543M in 2016) and a reduced workforce (~6,100 full-time-equivalent employees); the divested Personalized and Document Imaging product businesses completed their staged transfer to the pension-plan purchasing parties by September 2015, missed their first post-sale adjusted-EBITDA target (triggering a $4 million purchase-price repayment in 2016), and no goodwill impairment was indicated at December 31, 2016. [SRC: SEC accession 0001564590-17-003570, Form 10-K (FY2016)]

[SLICE END]
